title: Purification of Viral RNA Using MagMAX Viral RNA Isolation Kit
author: Erika Bujaki
materials: To process samples from FTA cards, prepare all the reagents listed, to start from liquid cell culture isolates prepare reagents in steps 1.3-1.6 only.
Select the MVRI_DUO_SV_300ul Protocol and press start.

Label and prepare the processing plates according to the table below: Using an automated multidispenser pipette with appropriate combitips tips or the use of multichannel pipettes is recommended for the following steps for maintaining accuracy with solutions containing alcohols and to reduce repetitive strain. Adjust volume and use a new tip for each solution.
Add 200 μl of prepared wash solution 1 to the 96 deep well plates marked FW1 and SW
Add 300 μl of prepared wash solution 2 of the 96 deep well plates marked FW2 and SW
Add 60 μl of nuclease free water to wells of the 96-standard plate marked Elution.
Place a 96 tip comb in a 96-standard plate.

Setting up the processing plates The clean reagents should be added to the plate in a separate dedicated area, away from where samples are handled to avoid contamination.. 1. Label and prepare the processing plates according to the table below: Using an automated multidispenser pipette with appropriate combitips tips or the use of multichannel pipettes is recommended for the following steps for maintaining accuracy with solutions containing alcohols and to reduce repetitive strain. Adjust volume and use a new tip for each solution. 2. Add 200 μl of prepared wash solution 1 to the 96 deep well plates marked FW1 and SW1. 3. steps.title: Prepare DTT Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1M DTT solution for storage.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 0.6168g of DTT in 4 ml of Nuclease Free water.
Sterilize using a 0.45 µm syringe filter unit and a 5 ml syringe.
Prepare aliquots and store at -20°C.

steps.title: Prepare RNA Processing Buffer
steps.instruction: Combine components to prepare RNA Processing Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Combine components as required for the number of samples.
Store on ice or store at -20°C for up to six months.

steps.title: Prepare Wash Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare Wash Solution 1 and Wash Solution 2 from concentrates.

substeps.instruction: Add the indicated volume of 100% Isopropanol to the Wash Solution 1 Concentrate bottle; mix by inverting at least 5 times and mark the bottle.
Add the indicated volume of 100% ethanol to the Wash Solution 2 Concentrate bottle; mix by inverting at least 5 times and mark the bottle.
Optionally take aliquots of prepared solutions to avoid contamination during multiple uses.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis/Binding Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the Lysis/Binding Solution on the day of use.

substeps.instruction: Defrost Carrier RNA on ice.
Combine components in the indicated order, adding an extra 10% to account for pipetting loss.
Add Carrier RNA to Lysis/Binding Solution Concentrate according to the table and mix briefly.
Add 100% isopropanol and mix well by vortexing.
Keep at room temperature with a tightened lid.

steps.title: Prepare Bead Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the nucleic acid binding bead mix on the day of use.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the nucleic acid binding beads well to ensure full resuspension.
Combine the listed components and mix well by vortexing.
Store on ice or in the fridge (do not freeze) for up to 4 hours.

steps.title: Process FTA Cards (Optional)
steps.instruction: Extract sample material from FTA cards if not using liquid isolates.

substeps.instruction: Set the thermal block to 70°C.
Label clean nuclease-free 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Place a cutting mat under the FTA card marked area.
Using a new 4mm disposable punch, punch seven (7) discs per sample into the labeled tube; dispose of punch in sharps bin after each card.
Aliquot 300 μl of RNA Processing Buffer into each tube.
Close and vortex tubes at high speed for 40 seconds.
Incubate tubes at 70°C for 5 minutes at 800 rpm (or vortex briefly every 2 minutes if not using a thermomixer).
Vortex and centrifuge tubes briefly to collect content; recover up to ~240 µl of supernatant for extraction.

steps.title: Manual RNA Extraction (Small Volume)
steps.instruction: Perform manual extraction using magnetic beads and centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 400 μl of Lysis/Binding Solution into labeled 1.5 ml DNA LoBind tubes.
Transfer 200 μl of liquid isolate (or FTA supernatant) to the tubes; mix by vortexing for 30s and spin briefly.
Add 14 μl of prepared bead mix to each tube; mix by pipetting using a new tip for each sample.
Mix thoroughly at gentle speed for 4 min (shaker, rotator, or manual rotation/vortex) until a homogenous colored mixture is achieved.
Centrifuge briefly, place on magnet for at least 2 minutes, and carefully aspirate/discard supernatant (centrifuge again if needed to remove all supernatant).
Wash with Wash Solution 1: Add 200 µl, vortex at moderate speed for 30s, centrifuge, capture on magnet until clear, and discard supernatant. Repeat once (2 washes total).
Wash with Wash Solution 2: Add 300 µl, vortex at moderate speed for 30s, centrifuge, capture on magnet for 2 mins or until clear, and discard supernatant. Repeat once (2 washes total).
Centrifuge briefly and remove residual solution with a fine-tipped pipette.
Dry beads by leaving the tube open for 2 minutes (do not overdry).
Add 50 µL Elution Buffer and shake/vortex vigorously for 4 min.
Centrifuge briefly, capture beads on magnet, and collect the purified RNA supernatant in labeled containers on ice or frozen.

steps.title: Automated Extraction: King Fisher Duo Prime
steps.instruction: Perform automated extraction using the King Fisher Duo Prime instrument.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the 12-tip magnet and heating block are installed (use 'Change Magnetic Head' protocol if necessary).
Prepare a 96 deep-well plate: Row A (400 μl Lysis/Binding Solution), Rows B-C (200 μl Wash Solution 1), Rows D-E (300 μl Wash Solution 2), and Row H (12-tip comb).
Add 60 μl of Elution buffer/nuclease free water to the elution strip tube.
Transfer 200 μl of liquid isolate (or 200-240 μl FTA supernatant) to Row A; mix by gentle pipetting.
Add 14 μl of prepared bead mix to Row A using a new tip for each addition; mix by pipetting.
Load the sample plate (matching A1 marking) and the elution strip (matching red conical protrusion) onto the turntable.
Run the MVRI_DUO_SV_300ul protocol and close the front lid.
Unload the elution strip and sample plate upon completion; transfer RNA to labeled containers on ice or frozen.

steps.title: Automated Extraction: King Fisher Flex
steps.instruction: Perform automated extraction using the King Fisher Flex instrument.

substeps.instruction: Import the MVRI_Flex_SV_300ul program and run a mock test.
Prepare a 96 deep-well 'Sample plate': Aliquot 400 μl of Lysis/Binding Solution into the wells.
Add 200-240 μl of sample (liquid isolate or FTA supernatant) to the wells; mix by gentle pipetting.
Add 14 μl of prepared bead mix to each well using a new tip for every addition; mix by pipetting.
Confirm 96 deep-well magnetic head and heat block are installed.
Load the plate, select the MVRI_Flex_SV_300ul protocol, and start; close the front lid.
Unload the plate upon completion and transfer eluted viral RNA to labeled containers on ice or frozen.
